posts.subject: Ranks
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello dear admin team,


I have a little suggestion/problem that is going on for quite long time. It is a simple thing. As you can see in subject it is about ranks (on knife server). If you will look at top players there, you will see names which are not playing there anymore and they just connect sometimes to keep that rank. That in my opinion is not why rank system is there. So I am asking @Nachtfrische @BlackFire and other people doing plugins and managing servers if there is something that can be done about that so we can see who is really the best player and stuff like that.


Thanks for reading.


Thorin 😛

Well, I already discuss about that with @Nachtfrische and for know I don't think we can do something about it because it would mean that we need to judge who is inactive or not and I don't think it would be cool to do that.
Well that is sad 🙁 But I get the point and I kinda knew that there is not efficient option. But what about reseting ranks? 😏 😏 😏

the thing is that most of the players would be mad then. Also we already have automatic reset if players did not play a long time. That is exactly what you discribed. I dont know if there is an option which allows us to reset the rank if a player dindt play at least 10 mins a month. I think that only works via connects. (Means: a player connects and instandly leaves server, his rank will kor be resetted because he "played" on the servers)

Zitat von Mike

I think that only works via connects. (Means: a player connects and instandly leaves server, his rank will kor be resetted because he "played" on the servers)

That's the point. We've got no other way to regulate/measure player inactivity atm.

i agree with @Thorin Pikachu it's literally almost (literally almost nice landon mason) impossible to rank up because of the people that are higher rank only because they don't play/notactive! well a other problem that I think (my opinion) is should be fix is how much a new player can get points by killing a higher rank player, and i know that is like these on almost every server but I honestly think knife server is different because a basic 2v1 can always happen and you gonna lose a lot points/rank . one of my friends that used to play a lot on knife server (ruby) but she didn't play for like 2 or 3 or 4 months (kappa) I'm not sure but it was one hundred presents more than a month but she was still rank 19 or something close like that! is removing inactive players system braking or ? because every thing used to be ok In passed (I mean before the ranking system got removed and added back again) #makerankingsystemgreatagain @Nachtfrische @BlackFire @Sky @OxygeN @WHAT

From my understanding after working with @Nachtfrische we talked about reseting someones rank after certain amount of time ( If I'm wrong correct me Nacht ) also as @Mike said we can't just remove the top players because if they are active and they see their rank being gone they will just say to his friends not to visit dream which means player loss, also this creates top 1 rank being harder to get so it's like challenge for other players to get rank 1.


Let @Nachtfrische give his statement as he knows what we have in knife server ( plugins etc. )
Except that "challenge" part I agree with you @OxygeN. It is difficult topic and there is no good way to solve that.

I'm not saying that we should reset the ranks @OxygeN my point was we should fix/change how much point a new player can get by killing a higher rank player (because most of the people that 2v1 they are probably new and lower ranks and dont know the rules), and as i said i think removing inactive players is not working or if its working its pretty slow [nothing-to-say*]

And there is also a slight issue with the !top, players that are #1 and #2 and those top ranks, they join, stay like 2-3 min and leave...why? they wanna keep there ranks so NOONE else can get them aaand they don't wanna lose them themself *cough* cause they are bad *cough* seen this so many times by now aswell

Actually today Aufstraggriller (sorry for ruining his name) connected and he was still rank 19 or around that. When I and @BadMasonBadboi asked him how long he has been out, he said that he didnt connect for 4 months. So there is an evidence that something is not alright. But no pressure, it is not that important (NOT IRONY)

I looked it up and found out that currently the plugin is configured to not delete player records but simply hide them, if they haven't connected in a certain time span.
An idea of mine would be to introduce a form of "seasons" as known from Star Craft, Dead By Deadlight and many other competetive games: A season is a defined time period (e.g. 6 months) after which the player records are resetted and a new season begins.


We could award top 3 players at the end of each season & it'd solve the problem of inactive ranks.
i really like that idea and i hope that solve the problem thanks @BlackFire
@BlackFire very good idea but the period of time could be shorter for example 2 months, cause half year is too much in my opinion.

I will stay neutral on the seasons idea of @BlackFire.


It's not that i don't like it it's just i don't want dream server to become like some shitty Leagues of Legends.
